xcc (https://github.com/tyfkda/xcc), MIT licence -- see LICENSE.
wccfiles.js is the project's own browser build (compiler cc.wasm, wlibc,
headers) as published by its CI at https://tyfkda.github.io/xcc/wccfiles.zip
(downloaded 2026-10-26, sha1 e5e15b65c58b20a37c99e763a24fdf58b110d45c; source at commit
631e318432aeaaf72d6d2dfc93085766934314a2), stored as base64 in a script so a
page opened from disk (file://) can load it -- such a page cannot fetch files.
Regenerate: base64 the zip into self.XCC_BUNDLE_B64 = "...".
Used by js/xcc-runner.js as the offline C compiler for Run Code / Check Code.
